products.product_description: Sunny Side Farms Peanut Butter Cup Ice Cream; 48 oz. carton, 1.5 QTS (1.42L) UPC: 7-17544-20740 5 Allergens for Peanut Butter Cup: Milk, Peanuts, Soy, Coconut.
